notes.title: New Update
notes.notes:
Hello, Fake Lay players, 

If you haven’t been keeping in touch with our latest updates, you can be sure our team has been busy bringing new features to the game. 

Besides making it available on MacOS, we would like to introduce you also to the new Fake Lay achievements. Of course, if you want to spice things up, you can do that by entering the double dildo competition. Make sure to join now, as it's a limited time fun. <3
  
We’re always on the lookout for improvements we can make and new content ideas, so make sure you drop us a line below. 

Thank you for all your support, and we look forward to hearing your thoughts.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1191420/Fake_Lay/

See you in-game!

The Fake Lay team,
